desc:
🦀 One Piece: Final (OPF) 🏴‍☠️

Your goal is to grow stronger, uncover ancient powers, and ultimately reach your Final Form. Along the way, you will search for rare fruits, unlock incredible abilities, and push your limits to awaken your Second Fruit, a power possessed by only the most extraordinary pirates.

Current fruits in the game:
Common: Spin, Luck , Clear, Chop, Clone, Float, Hot, Swim, Spring, Slip, More
Uncommon: Barrier, Love, Smelt, Order, Diamond, Bomb, Slow, Hobby
Rare: Candy, Chilly, Flare, Sand, Magma, Rumble, Light, Ope, Plasma, Snow, Gravity, Gas, Gum, String, Paw, Venom
Ultra Rare: Dark, Buddha, Quake, Phoenix, Vampire

Contributors:
GODoSLAYER (Main Theme Music)
Zoma_Ego (Model)

All credits goes to:
